name: Voidbound
summary:
(Game currently in closed early access)
Voidbound is here!
Voidbound is home to the NebulaNex Station!
Here we have a variety of different activities to enjoy and scenic spaces to unwind and relax!

Wanna play zero-g games with your friends? 
Wanna gaze into the endless abyss of space? 
Wanna join a welcoming community of robots new and old?
All of your robot needs can be found right here at the NebulaNex station!
